summary: Frontend-only testing of databased.business Astro 5 SSG. All pages load 200, all critical flows work: hero, featured/taxonomy/recent/manifesto sections, blog index with filter chips, flagship blog post with TLDR + sections 01-08 + 2 tables + 8 code blocks, 6 model cards with SVG wireframes, /code page live-fetched 15 real GitHub repos with 6 language filters working, RSS XML valid with all 4 posts, footer links present on all pages, 3 older blog posts load with new BlogPost layout. 28/29 frontend checks passed. Only failure: 58px horizontal overflow on 375px mobile viewport caused by hero headline 'transparent / opaque.' not scaling down. Naming mismatch between requested nav testids and actual implementation (functional equivalents exist).

ui_bugs.issue: On 375px mobile viewport, hero headline 'transparent / opaque.' is 433px wide and forces 58px horizontal scroll. Font size does not scale down at small breakpoints. Other viewports (768, 1440) are fine.

issues: Hero headline overflows viewport horizontally by ~58px — needs clamp() or smaller @media (max-width:480px) font-size on .hero h1

testid_naming_mismatches.note: All functional equivalents exist and work correctly. Either update Header.astro/HeaderLink.astro to use the requested testid names, or update the test spec. No functional impact — navigation, active-link highlighting, and routing all work.
Three manifesto axes render correctly; just missing data-testid attributes on the article.axis elements.

passed_checks: All routes return 200: /, /blog/, /code/, /models/, /rss.xml, all 4 blog post pages
All home sections present: hero, featured-section, taxonomy-section, recent-section, manifesto-section, site-footer
Taxonomy 3 surface cards present (surface-blog, surface-models, surface-code)
Navigation: nav-link-01 navigates to /blog and gets .active class highlight
Blog index has filter chips (filter-all + 4 tag filters); filter-credit-default hides 3 of 4 posts; filter-all restores all 4
Flagship blog post: blog-post testid present, TLDR present, section numbers 01-08 all rendered, 2 tables, 8 code blocks
Models page: 6 model cards with SVG wireframes and metadata (medium/year/polys/status)
Code page: 15 live-fetched GitHub repos from Julian-Elliott (no rate-limit fallback), 6 language filter buttons, 17 github.com links
Older posts (data-democratisation-playbook, data-literacy-labs, governance-without-gatekeeping) load with new BlogPost layout
RSS feed at /rss.xml returns valid XML with all 4 posts including correct pubDate/link/description
Footer present on all pages with footer-github, footer-linkedin, footer-bluesky, footer-email
Responsive: no horizontal overflow at 1440px and 768px
action_items: Fix mobile hero overflow: add font-size clamp() or @media (max-width:480px) rule to .hero h1 (currently overflows by 58px at 375px)

Either rename testids in Header.astro/HeaderLink.astro to brand-mark/nav-index/nav-blog/nav-models/nav-code/nav-rss to match spec, OR update test plan to use existing names (nav-link-00..03, rss-link, brand-link)
Add data-testid='axis-x'/'axis-y'/'axis-z' to the three .axis articles in /app/src/pages/index.astro manifesto section
critical_code_review_comments: Header data-testid naming is inconsistent with rest of site: other testids are descriptive (surface-blog, filter-credit-default) but nav uses numeric index (nav-link-00). Consider semantic naming (nav-blog, nav-models) for easier test maintenance.
/app/src/lib/github.ts: fetch executes at SSR/build time — verify ETag/conditional requests or build cache to avoid hitting api.github.com on every dev reload (currently working but worth checking).
Hero responsive sizing not using clamp() — vulnerable to overflow on narrow screens. Recommend `font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 12vw, 6rem)` on .hero h1.

Lang filter for 'jupyter notebook' on /code showed 15->15 (no change) — verify filter logic counts repos correctly when only 1-2 match a language; may be a minor false-positive in this test since I only verified click registered.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is Astro SSG at /app (not /app/frontend). Public URL: https://2e03f96f-3c00-4ef2-babf-b5437f079390.preview.emergentagent.com. No backend. GitHub fetch is real (live 15 repos returned). Main remaining issue: mobile hero font-size overflow at <=480px viewports. Testid naming: actual nav uses nav-link-00..03 (not nav-blog/etc), brand-link (not brand-mark), rss-link (not nav-rss). Filter chips at /blog use data-testid='filter-{tag}'. Repo cards: repo-card-*, lang filters: lang-filter-*. Footer: footer-github/linkedin/bluesky/email.
rca_of_the_issue: Mobile overflow RCA: The .hero h1 (transparent / opaque.) uses a fixed large font-size in global.css/index.astro <style> that does not include a @media (max-width:480px) downsizing rule, nor a CSS clamp(). At 375px viewport the rendered text width is 433px (right edge at 425px for 'opaque' span + period span at 433px), causing 58px overflow. Fix: add `font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 14vw, 6.5rem)` or a media query lowering font-size below 480px to .hero h1 / .signal.
